name: agent-validation-v430
description: Agent validation v4.3.0: Entropy disabled (cosine only), tiered fitness gate (strict/moderate), auto-best checkpoints, cross-run learning in prompts, phase gate 15%. Trigger when: (1) running agent A/B experiments, (2) agents never acting during training, (3) agents hurting performance with entropy changes, (4) configuring reward weight phase gates, (5) adding cross-run learning to agent prompts, (6) setting up production-length experiments (200M+).
